name: Iori
message: 「Next up, Asahi！」
As if swapping places with Ririmu, Asahi stepped forward.

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m already prepared. I’m ready whenever you are.」

name: Iori
message: 「Then let’s get started right away.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Are you sure you don’t need a break, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I’ve still got plenty of energy.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san, thanks for acting as her warm-up partner.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I swear, one day I’m gonna kill you！」

name: Asahi
message: 「By the way, Iori-sensei, may I ask you something？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Earlier, when you were sparing with Ririmu-san, you started acting a bit strange halfway through...」

name: Iori
message: 「Acting strange？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes. You were backing up when nothing was there, and your gaze was darting in strange directions.」
Could that be...

name: Iori
message: （I see, so that phantom isn't visible to anyone but the opponent...！）
During my training with Ririmu, Setsugekka and the others didn't seem surprised. I thought it was odd, but that explains it.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sensei, what I showed you earlier is a secret between just the two of us, okay~?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I got it.」
So that phantom is Ririmu’s secret weapon, huh.
Well, it’ll naturally come out when the students spar with each other, so it’s not for me to go blabbing about.

name: Asahi
message: 「A secret between you and Iori-sensei... that’s intriguing.」

name: Iori
message: 「You should try sparring with Ririmu sometime. You’ll understand then.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood. I look forward to exposing that secret one of these days.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, what's with the way you say things！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Come now, Iori-sensei, I’m tired of waiting. Let’s start already.」

name: Iori
message: 「You got it！」
I drew my Origami and took my stance. Asahi took her stance without drawing hers.

name: Iori
message: 「Can we go all out today？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I don't mind.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'd like to fight the Tenju Special Forces side of Iori-sensei that I don't know yet, too.」
Thank goodness—looks like I won't have to use Tengen Saimei-ryuu.

name: Iori
message: 「All right, here I come！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Whenever you're ready.」
Taking a half-turned stance, Asahi quietly probes my every move.
The instant I step into range, she draws and slashes at me. However, I already figured out Asahi's range and strike patterns during our last practice.
Effortlessly deflecting her blade, I surge right into her guard in a single burst.

name: Iori
message: 「Keep up with me, Asahi！！」
I unleash a flurry of strikes at Asahi, giving her no room to even catch her breath.
In response, Asahi fights back with her drawn Origami and deflects every single blow.
Asahi's form is remarkably refined, and when it comes to defense, her stability is second to none.

name: Iori
message: 「Your greatest strength is your high defensive ability, Asahi！」

name: Iori
message: 「No matter the angle of attack, once you decide to block it, you never let a blade through！」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you praise me like that, I'll get so happy I might make a mistake!」
Iai quick-draw holds killing in a single strike as its ideal. To achieve that, however, one must catch the opponent off guard.
To use it in a match like Jindou, she had to endure patiently until the right opportunity arrived.
And what supports that patience is this ironclad defense of Asahi's.

name: Iori
message: 「Then how about this...！！」
This time I weave in feints—yet she blocks them all cleanly.
I deliberately created an opening to bait out a counterattack, but Asahi refuses to fall for such a cheap provocation.
Here too, Asahi remains patient and rock-steady.

name: Iori
message: 「Still, you can't win just by defending！！」
Asahi keeps backing away to create distance, while I stay right on her heels, showering her relentlessly with naked steel.
Because of that, Asahi can't return her blade to its scabbard.

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm happy to have Sensei chasing me around, truly, but...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Could you please back off just a little...？！」
Asahi forced our blades into a lock.

name: Iori
message: 「No way, I can't let you have that...！！」
I put all my strength into pushing forward... yet Asahi didn't give an inch.

name: Iori
message: 「Heh, you’ve got more strength than I thought！」
Even though Tenju can bolster physical strength, if your base muscle power is low, it’s impossible to push through in a struggle like this.
And yet, Asahi is resisting my push—and strength training is a part of my job.

name: Asahi
message: 「Hnn… I haven’t been training lightly, either!」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. Well then, let’s see just how much you can take…！」
I gradually shift the Tenju I’d been channeling into my feet for an explosive dash—in case Asahi tried to retreat—over into my arm strength instead.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ugh… ngh…！」
Asahi makes a pained face as I put my full strength into pushing her back.

name: Iori
message: 「…You’re impressive, Asahi.」
There probably aren't many academy students who could withstand my full power.

name: Iori
message: 「On top of having a rock-solid defense, you’ve got muscle to back it up.」

name: Iori
message: 「Once you master that, you can become even stronger than you are now！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you… so much…！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Though, there’s still room for improvement when it comes to your offense！」
I exploit the opening created when she relaxes her power and her center of gravity shifts slightly, landing a strike on her Barrier Jacket.

name: Iori
message: 「Being cautious is a great virtue, but sometimes you won't see a chance to win unless you're willing to take a gamble！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I know that…！」
Asahi says this while retreating. I instantly close the distance.
And so, Asahi was forced back into a one―sided defensive struggle again―.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, what are you doing！」
Ririmu, who was watching from the sidelines, shouts in frustration.

name: Ririmu
message: 「That Kijo, she’s not gonna win if she doesn’t go on the offensive！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, don’t you think so too, Momichi？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hm, well, I suppose so.」
This girl Ririmu was so overly familiar right from the start that I didn't like her much at first.
But her attitude hasn't changed at all, even after I started speaking more naturally.
She’s probably the type who doesn’t put up barriers with anyone. I find that easy to deal with, and I’ve grown to appreciate it.

name: Momiji
message: 「Asahi seems to rely mostly on her Iai sword arts, so I suppose it’s inevitable that she ends up on the defensive.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Still… even so, she’s almost too cautious, or perhaps I should say, timid.」
Iori had said something similar just a moment ago, but if I don't go on the offensive even when the odds are bad, there's no chance of victory.

name: Momiji
message: 「What are you so scared of...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Don't tell me that Kijo is actually afraid of Sensei？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wow, how pathetic~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, it’s not that simple.」
Looking at their interactions so far, Sensei and Asahi must have known each other for a long time and understand each other quite well.
If so, this caution might be because she knows his true strength.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I’ll ask him about it later.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, Momimomi~」

name: Momiji
message: 「That nickname really rubs me the wrong way.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wonder if Muragaki-sensei is an infighter like me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「See, he’s sticking right to Asahi-chan as she tries to run, making sure not to let any distance open up.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Iai sword-drawing requires you to put the blade back into the sheath after every strike.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But if he stays that close and keeps landing hits like that, there’s no way she could sheath her blade.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, he’s forcing an infight to seal off the drawing-style attacks that are Asahi’s greatest strength.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I see, he’s so smart~. I should try that too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Seriously, you... you should try using your head like that when you fight, you know？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, I’m not really good at using my head.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I usually just leave all that stuff to Kei-chan.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So Keisetsu took all the brains, huh? How pitiful...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Shut it！ I’ve gone through life wondering if that might be the case myself, but it pisses me off when someone else says it！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahahaha, Secchan is such an airhead, that’s why~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Look who’s talking, you’re the one always failing those pop quizzes!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, hey, Secchan！ How do you know about that！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehe~, Asahi-chan told me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That Kijo...！」
Beside me, Setsugekka and Ririmu start making a ruckus. These two, they actually get along surprisingly well.
I keep my gaze fixed on the match between the teacher and Asahi, thinking.
Asahi is nearing her limit.
Every time she takes one of Iori-sensei's strikes, the Origami in her hand is being pushed back by centimeters.
Her arms are screaming because she’s been taking his heavy blows one after another.
Furthermore, Iori-sensei has been weaving subtle feints into his striking lines each time. Because of that, Asahi is forced to waste extra energy every time she blocks.

name: Momiji
message: （That looks even tougher than it seems...）
Things I’ve realized from watching Ririmu and Asahi's matches.
It’s that Iori―sensei is more of a monster than I’d expected―

name: Asahi
message: 「Aahhh...！！」
Asahi's solid defense has started to crumble bit by bit.
From continuing to receive my strikes, her concentration and arm strength have been whittled away, and she has finally reached her limit.
Once it comes to this, there's no way forward.

name: Iori
message: 「That's it for now, Asahi！！！」
The overhead strike aiming for her forearm and the torso slash released immediately after both landed perfectly.

name: Iori
message: 「...All right, let's stop here.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa, haa... Thank you very much.」
Asahi bows her head as she sheathes her blade, her breathing heavy.

name: Ririmu
message: 「What, what just happened？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That Kijo hasn't even collapsed yet.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's because Asahi's Barrier Jacket is almost at zero.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh, it’s already over even though she barely got any hits on Sensei？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That’s no good, you know.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I just got criticized by someone who was groveling on the ground in a pathetic display as the first one up♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You...! That’s a really nasty way to put it!」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, alright, stop the bickering.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But Sensei, she's being mean！」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, try not to provoke people needlessly.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Seriously, you only ever show your good side to Sensei...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Of course. Iori-sensei is a god, after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I’m not a god. I’m just a public servant, okay?」
Ah, right. I’d forgotten to ask something important.

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, I want to hear it from you, too. What is your dream for the future？」

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s a foolish question, Iori-sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「My dream is to become Iori-sensei’s wife and spend the rest of my life by your side%0」

name: Iori
message: 「No, cut the jokes！ Give me a serious answer！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I don’t intend to be joking, but...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, there’s no point in troubling Iori-sensei here, so let’s save this talk for another time.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「She never wavers, does she, Asahi-chan?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「She’s a total fanatic, that one.」

name: Asahi
message: 「My goal as a student, of course, is to become a Toujinegi.」

name: Iori
message: 「Understood. Then I shall provide guidance with that in mind.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I’m counting on you!」
